pages.title: Von Neumann Probe
pages.text: A self-replicating machine that builds copies of itself from whatever material it finds. Send one to a star system and it builds more, which build more, until every star has one. Von Neumann proved such machines were possible. This one is small, neat and patient.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Nanite Assembler I gave a Dyson Swarm Satellite claytronic catoms and a Quantum Processor, so it could fabricate its own parts. It began printing a copy of itself before I had finished writing the entry.
